headline: Review of draft CPRB guidelines for evaluating internal affairs cases, training procedures, and a vote on IA case review findings.
summary: The board will review draft guidelines for evaluating IA cases, training procedures, and the duties of the community liaison. It will also hold an executive session on IA case reviews and vote on the findings.
items: Review draft CPRB guidelines for evaluating IA cases
Executive session: discussion of IA case(s) for review
Vote regarding IA case review findings
